As-of mid-September 2020, immediately after the 12-13 September nighttime reconnaissance of the Michigan governor's vacation home (per federal and state trial records). Evidence in hand at that moment, via confidential human sources and undercover employees inside the group: a specific named target; daytime and boat-based surveillance of the residence in late August; a nighttime vehicle reconnaissance of the home including inspection of the underside of a nearby highway bridge for explosive placement to slow law-enforcement response; repeated field training exercises; attempted construction and test detonation of improvised explosive devices; and active discussion of purchasing explosives. This is preparation behavior converging on a specific person and place — the behavior class of this indicator. Proximity at_or_near_target: the cell physically reached the residence's surroundings during reconnaissance and could return. Source credibility high: multiple independent informants and undercover officers with recordings. Conditioned priority critical — equal to the type band, which already sits at the ceiling; the instance record documents that every factor independently corroborates the ceiling rather than raising it.
